description:
Re-map a repo now. Every repo is mapped during the trial and on Pro, and re-maps on every push.

• refresh_repo { repo, full? }: queue a re-map of one repo.
• set_free_repo { repo }: retired; it changes nothing, since there is no live repo to choose.

CALL THIS WHEN:
• A repo's graph looks out of date, or needs a full rebuild

RETURNS: The queued job.

full.description: refresh_repo only: rebuild the whole graph instead of a delta refresh

name: pharaoh_manage_repo
title: Refresh Repo
